en: Sepia-toned historical image showing a large military parade moving through a narrow city street lined with multi‑story buildings. Soldiers in uniform march in formation, many carrying drums, while dense crowds fill the sidewalks. Numerous flags hang from the façades, prominently including French tricolours and at least one American flag. A shop sign reading "AU BON …" is visible on the right-hand side. The overall look is of an early 20th‑century celebration or victory parade in a French city.
